packageRules.description: Microsoft.Build 18.10+ only ships net11.0/net472 runtime assets; our net10.0 consumers can't load it. Remove once the repo targets net11.0.
The internals-access task supports net8.0 and net472 hosts; keep its compile-time MSBuild APIs and in-process test runtime on the net8.0-compatible 17.11 servicing line.
Roslyn versions are chosen deliberately: analyzers and generators must load in older compilers (SDKs/IDEs), so they and their tests reference old Roslyn APIs.
Microsoft.VisualStudio.Threading.Analyzers 18.7.65+ is built against Roslyn 4.11, but TUnit.Analyzers.Tests compiles against Roslyn 4.8 (CS1705).

FSharp.Core is the dependency floor of the published TUnit.Assertions.FSharp package. An 11.x floor fails restore (NU1605) for F# projects built with the .NET 10 SDK, which reference FSharp.Core 10.x.
Packages versioned with the .NET runtime stay on the major matching their target framework (per-TFM groups in Directory.Packages.props, plus net10.0 examples and templates): keep 8.x entries on 8.x.
As above: keep 10.x entries (net10.0 and the default group) on 10.x.
Per-TFM versions in Directory.Packages.props: keep the net8.0/net10.0 OpenTelemetry entries on 1.20.x (1.21 needs .NET 11 packages); the net11.0 entries are uncapped.
